errorDescription: An error occurred while rendering the page
connectionFailed: Connection failed. Please check if the backend service is running
welcome.title: Open a workspace
welcome.subtitle: Start from a local folder, or connect to a project directory on a remote host.
welcome.localDescription: Choose a folder on this computer and open its sessions and files.
welcome.remoteDescription: Save an SSH host profile, then choose a remote directory to open as a project.
welcome.remoteDialogSubtitle: Save a host profile and open a remote directory as a workspace.
welcome.remoteConfigSubtitle: Choose an SSH alias, then enter the remote project directory to open.
welcome.remoteDetectedHint: Selecting an alias fills host, port, username, and key path.
welcome.remoteAliasHint: Use aliases from ~/.ssh/config first so IP, port, and key settings stay centralized.
welcome.remoteStepMethodHint: Choose SSH or another remote runtime mode.
welcome.remoteSshMethodHint: Connect to an existing host, deploy a lightweight runtime, then choose a remote folder.
welcome.remoteStandardSshHint: Start a complete Agent runtime on the remote host. Skills, memory, agents, and sessions belong to the remote runtime.
welcome.remoteQuickSandboxHint: Zero-install command forwarding for quick checks. Local memory, skills, and agents stay unavailable.
welcome.remoteDockerComingSoon: Local container mode will come later. Use SSH for now.
welcome.remoteStepResourcesHint: Confirm low-risk resources to carry into the remote runtime.
welcome.remoteStepConnectHint: Prepare runtime and open the workspace
welcome.remoteTestOk: Connected. The remote directory is accessible.
welcome.remoteError.missing-host: SSH host is missing. Choose an alias or enter a host.
welcome.remoteError.auth-failed: SSH authentication failed. Check the username, private key, or ~/.ssh/config.
welcome.remoteError.timeout: SSH connection timed out. Check the host, port, and network.
welcome.remoteError.host-unreachable: Cannot reach the SSH host. Check the host name, IP, or port.
welcome.remoteError.host-key: SSH host key verification failed. Confirm this host in a terminal first.
welcome.remoteError.ssh-config: SSH configuration is invalid. Check ~/.ssh/config, private key paths, and SSH options.
welcome.remoteError.remote-path: The remote directory does not exist or is not a directory.
welcome.remoteError.permission-denied: Permission denied on the remote directory. Choose a path you can access.
welcome.remoteError.command-failed: The remote command failed. See the raw error below.
welcome.remoteDirectoryBrowserHint: Choose the remote folder to open as a workspace, or create a new folder first.
welcome.remoteDirectoryEmpty: No child folders in this directory.
welcome.remoteSyncHint: Before opening the project, Pi generates a local manifest hash and compares it with the remote synced manifest. Matching hashes skip upload. Sensitive files, cache folders, and symlinks are excluded automatically.
welcome.remoteSyncEmptyWarning: Sync is enabled but no resources are selected. Opening the project will skip resource sync.
welcome.remoteSyncBlockedSummary: Safety rules excluded {{count}} file(s) or folder(s).
welcome.remoteSyncUnsupportedHint: Hooks, MCP, plugins, model credentials, memory, and sessions are not copied in this step. Standard SSH loads those from the remote machine and remote project.
welcome.remoteOpeningHint: Creating the local mapping and starting the remote runtime. This closes automatically when ready.
